spans.s:
पुच्छ पुच्छ, अस्, अम्, m. n. a tail; the
hinder part; the tail of a peacock; a horse's tail;
any hairy tail; the end of anything; [cf. probably
Gr. πῡγή, perhaps πύματος.]
—पुच्छ-जाह, अम्,
n. the root of the tail.
—पुच्छ-दा, f. a bulbous
plant used as a remedy for sterility, = लक्ष्म-
ना-कन्द; (probably a corruption of पुत्र-दा.)
[]
—पुच्छ-धि, इस्, m., Ved. the root of the tail.
—पुच्छ-मूल or पुच्छाग्र (˚छ-अग्˚), अम्, n.
the tip of the tail.
—पुच्छाण्डक (˚छ-अण्˚),
अस्, m., N. of a Nāga of the race of Takṣaka.
—पुच्छेश्वर (˚छ-ईश्˚), अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?),
N. of a place or of a temple.
पुच्छिका in क्रोष्टु-प्˚, क्रोष्टुक-प्˚, q. v.

पुच्छिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having a tail, tailed; a cock;
Calotropis Gigantea (= अर्क).

पुच्छटि पुच्छटि, इ, n. snapping or cracking
the fingers; [cf. मुचुटी.]
